meta.description: Sprint 5 Slice E — v2 (session_bookings) reminder dispatcher. Triggered by Next.js cron (`POST /api/cron/send-reminders`) which posts a `reminder_dispatch` event to this workflow's webhook. Acknowledges by writing a dedup row via Next.js's `notifications` UNIQUE index, renders the email inline, calls Resend, then records `reminder_sent` confirmation. Documented in n8n/docs/WORKFLOWS.md §2.10.
